synopsis: The corpus identifies ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 as a neutral standard for test documentation and says it separates test processes, design techniques and documentation [f13537, f6947]. Chapter 9 distinguishes discovery tests, which ask whether the system can be broken, from a frozen, pre-registered, stratified estimation sample, which measures success frequency in a defined population [f6666, f6667]. Deterministic requirement and regression tests serve a third purpose: checking whether a change has broken required behaviour [f6668]. The glossary also names ASAM MDF for measured signals and ASAM ATX for test specifications and results, but the supplied facts do not explicitly map Chapter 9’s three testing purposes to particular provisions of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 [f13537, f6947, f6666, f6667, f6668].

relations.note: Clarifies that 29119 covers processes and design techniques as well as documentation.
